verdict.rationale: Zep keeps memory per user by default: threads are ingested into each user's own Context Graph. It also documents UserGroups and ABAC policies on API keys that limit which context each agent and Memory MCP user can reach, which supports least-privilege separation of private memory. However, the evidence never shows a shared group or team graph, or a way to mark selected memory as shared across users or agents. Missing for 10: an explicit shared/group memory construct, documentation of selectively sharing memory items across users or agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
